'''Fleet Support Depot''' was a staging area on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] used for docking capital ships.

{{Loc-stub}}

==History==
[[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] and [[Omega Squad]] met up with [[Kal Skirata]] here after disembarking from the [[Majestic (Acclamator-class)|''Majestic'']].
